statement:
Everybody has access to the same AI capabilities.
Competitiveness comes down to asking better
questions and pipelines for channeling those
capabilities.

An LLM is a legitimate second coder in
qualitative research and should count toward
intercoder reliability.

We should treat fully autonomous AI scientists
making Nobel-worthy discoveries by 2050 as a
serious goal worth funding.

AI can engage in more flexible forms of
thinking than typical humans.

The institution of science would be better with
more AI agents and fewer human agents.
